regions.merged_text: "Dear Bernard - Here is a sample of young Bernard's letter-writing. Pray that if its God's will he may follow in your footsteps." If he keep the faith and try earnestly to save his immortal soul which means success in the one thing necessary, then he is following the footsteps of all the saints. I certainly trust you are all so doing. From the "first and last letter ... " so far: Dear Father Bernard I was 7 years old March 7 and am in the second grade at school. I made my first Holy Comunion just a year ago. I have a May alter and love to say my prayers at night in front of it. Thomas is 5 years old. Rosemary is 3 years old and we have a new baby Owen Joseph he will be 4 weeks old next Sunday .. ... "I like my Sister at school very much her name is Sister Bernard. Papa and Mama are well and are good to us children. Please pray for your little nefue Bernard Brady". Quite a letter for a little seven-year-old. Not? · There were indications quit often since that little letter was penciled, that the writer would land somewhere nearer a monastery than would at present seem ever likely. God's ways, however, are so sublimely above our limited reckoning that we are simply lost when we venture to fathom even their shad- ows. So let us praise and adore Him in His decrees and in the very shadows of His adorable omnipotent wisdom - Power - Mercy - GOODNESS -- PROVIDENCE. I tried to get this off yesterday but it is now Friday. . . God bless you and your associates as well as your dear Parents and all your dear ones -- your enemies too if you have any, that they - that we all - be converted to God.
